contentBlocks.text: You've learned ਨੂੰ and ਤੋਂ. Today: two more essential postpositions!

ਵਿੱਚ means 'in,' used the same way as the postpositions you already know: ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ means 'in the house.' ਨਾਲ means 'with,' as in ਦੋਸਤ ਨਾਲ, 'with a friend.' Translate the phrases 'in school' and 'with my friend' into Punjabi using ਵਿੱਚ and ਨਾਲ.
You just learned all four essential postpositions! Tomorrow we'll combine them into full sentences.

objectives: Correctly translate 'in school' and 'with my friend' using these postpositions
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's ਨੂੰ/ਤੋਂ work briefly.
2. Introduce ਵਿੱਚ and ਨਾਲ with the ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ/ਦੋਸਤ ਨਾਲ examples.
3. Have the child translate 'in school' and 'with my friend'.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's combined-sentences lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: review all four postpositions learned so far (ਨੂੰ, ਤੋਂ, ਵਿੱਚ, ਨਾਲ) together on one list before introducing new translation practice
Ready for more: ask the child to translate a sentence combining two postpositions, like 'I am going with my friend to school'
With all four postpositions now taught, the child has real, practical grammar directly usable in everyday conversation
teacherGuide.answerKey: 'In school' = ਸਕੂਲ ਵਿੱਚ. 'With my friend' = ਦੋਸਤ ਨਾਲ.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's advanced-grammar thread, completing the four most commonly used Punjabi postpositions.

generationData.instructions: Translate each phrase into Punjabi using ਵਿੱਚ or ਨਾਲ.
